title: Add first-trade completion quest with credit reward — retention/gamification
description: Add a new quest `quest_first_trade` worth 15 credits, awarded automatically when a member marks their first trade as mutually completed. Update `lib/quests.ts` with the new quest def, wire it into the trade completion flow in `lib/actions/trade-completions.ts`, and add unit tests covering the award logic (idempotent, only on first trade). Track completion in PostHog. Acceptance: quest appears in dashboard QuestCard, credits awarded on first mutual trade completion, no duplicate awards, tests pass.
notes: Added the quest_first_trade reward to mutual trade completion, surfaced it in quests, and covered eligibility + award behavior in unit tests. Commit: 9087cd5.

title: Add directory upgrade banner when free members hit contact limit — monetization
description: Show a sticky banner on /directory and /listings for free members who have exhausted their monthly contact limit. Banner surfaces Premium pricing, savings math, and a direct CTA to /dashboard/billing. Use live contact-limit status from `lib/data/contact-limit.ts`. Track impression and click in PostHog. Acceptance: banner only shows for free members at limit, uses live plan values, links to billing, unit tests cover visibility logic and CTA.
notes: Added a sticky Premium upsell banner on /directory and /listings for free members at the contact cap, with live pricing math and PostHog click/impression tracking. Commit: 926d193.

title: Add listing feature/boost credit sink for premium members — monetization/engagement
description: Let premium members spend 5 credits to 'feature' a listing for 7 days. Featured listings get a visual badge and a small ranking boost in discover/directory. Add `featured_until` timestamp to listings table, a 'Feature this listing' action in the listing edit flow, and deduct credits via the existing credit ledger. Gate to premium members only. Acceptance: feature action visible only to premium, credits deducted, badge renders on featured listings, ranking boost applied, unit tests cover gating and credit deduction.
notes: Added premium-only 5-credit listing featuring with featured_until ranking/badges in browse + edit flow and regression coverage. Commit: fc0e963.
